findings.invariant: since compares normalized instants; rows with iso >= since must remain readable
findings.evidence: Draft seed_after_since observed 4. Frame 4 at 2026-03-01T09:50:00Z is before since 09:55Z and raises the id watermark past frames 1 and 2 (10:00Z / 10:00:30Z). Trace: /work/out/row-sequence-trace.json cases.seed_after_since and current_code_since_seeded.events (transcriptions only).
findings.independent_expected: Seed should exclude only instants strictly before since. Frames 1 and 2 stay in range.
findings.current_code: max id among resolved.iso < since over a full ORDER BY id scan.
findings.existing_coverage: backfill.test.ts:198-223 and p1-regressions.test.ts:21-58 use monotonic times only. Do not duplicate those.
findings.required_fix: P082: either document the max-id approximation and its non-monotonic hole, or filter by resolved instant without advancing last_frame_id past an in-range earlier id.

findings.invariant: README: each call merges frame and audio streams in global occurrence order; settle pause does not skip the paused row
findings.evidence: SQL after id 2 limit 2 through 4 returned [3,4] (id order, not time). Settle drain at boundary 10:02Z emitted frame:1, transcription:1, transcription:2, frame:2, transcription:3 with last_frame_id=2, phase caught_up. Frame 4 at 09:50Z was held behind paused frame 3 at 10:05Z while transcription 3 at 10:00:40Z emitted.
findings.independent_expected: Global time order would emit frame:4 before transcription:3. A paused head should not let the other stream pass a held earlier-time later-id row.
findings.current_code: Each stream is ORDER BY id. Pause returns null for that walker; the merge treats it as empty and continues the other stream.
findings.existing_coverage: Monotonic merge: p1-regressions.test.ts:148-182. One-stream pause: backfill.test.ts:159-196. Cross-stream + non-monotonic hold is missing.
findings.required_fix: P082: decide whether id-order-plus-head-merge is the contract (then tighten README) or true global order (then stall both streams or time-sort within the snapshot page).

findings.invariant: Current README: malformed settled row fails the batch before a new checkpoint. Wave1 spec §5/§6: skip and count.
findings.evidence: Draft empty-text case: events=[], last_frame_id stays 4, phase parse_error, malformed frame:5 text. recordSkippedFrame is never called from walk. parseSkipTotal omits frames_without_text.
findings.independent_expected: Follow the current README: fail closed, no skip increment.
findings.current_code: Matches README. Skip counters are serialized leftovers.
findings.existing_coverage: Fail-closed: backfill.test.ts:143-157. Counter round-trip only: cursor.test.ts:20-32. Do not add a skip-and-count test without a contract choice.
findings.required_fix: P082: keep fail-closed, or implement skip-and-count and update README. Do not leave both stories live.

findings.invariant: SQL pages are bounded and named next to BATCH_LIMIT
findings.evidence: Hardcoded 64. Production BATCH_LIMIT 500 implies up to 8 pages per stream per call. No walk.test.ts.
findings.independent_expected: Named constant, covered by existing 1200-row batch test indirectly.
findings.existing_coverage: backfill.test.ts:49-76 exercises multiple pages but asserts only 500.
findings.required_fix: Optional: export WALK_PAGE=64 beside BATCH_LIMIT. Not a functional blocker.

findings.invariant: Exported bounds should be used or removed by their owner
findings.evidence: Exported from index.ts; not referenced in read.ts or walk.ts. Purge uses a separate PLAN_SQL_ROWS=256.
findings.existing_coverage: purge.test.ts uses it as a fixture size, not as a read-query bound.
findings.required_fix: Out of R084 write scope. P082 may ignore unless touching cursor exports.
